children: Pinterest's Adjusted Ebitda reaches $339 million in 3Q with a 29% margin, matching the prior year's margin. GAAP net income drops 77% to $22 million, reflecting $4.1 million in restructuring charges during the quarter. The company generated $300 million in free cash flow, down 6% from a year earlier. Pinterest expects 4Q revenue between $1.425 billion and $1.475 billion, representing 8% to 12% growth, with Adjusted Ebitda guidance of $538 million to $588 million.
